# High-Throughput Edge Streaming Architecture

## 1. System Overview
This document describes the architectural layout of our edge event broker connecting Cloudflare Workers with SQLite FTS5 indexing.

## 2. Invariants and Constraints
* Isolates have a strict memory ceiling of 128MB.
* SQLite FTS5 queries must enforce BM25 weights to prioritize titles and heading anchors.
* Outgoing WebSocket messages must use compact binary or plain-text formats to minimize serialization latency.

## 3. Production Configuration
```typescript
export const config = {
  maxPayloadBytes: 1024 * 512,
  timeoutMs: 15000,
  enableFts5Bm25: true
};
```

## 4. Verification and Benchmarks
Load-tested at 10,000 RPS using k6 with 0% dropped packets and P99 latency below 38ms.
